_note: Models a sealed box may use. Fixed in the image (so they are attested): the owner picks a provider by name and can never point the AI at a server of their own (that would let them answer in its place). A provider with model = null is not approved yet. The model actually used is written into the box manifest.

deepseek._note: DeepSeek's own API (founder, 26 Nov 2026: AGT depends on no single model provider). JSON mode only: the answer's schema is given in the request.

local._note: An open-weights model served INSIDE the box by llama.cpp (tee/box/Dockerfile.local). Its weights are downloaded at boot and refused unless their sha256 matches — so the model is as attested as the code.
